notes.title: [Food Wagon Dev Note] crowdfunding news & Snack Crafting System
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is Luminous Tales.[/p][p]In this update, we are sharing [b]crowdfunding news[/b] and introducing one of Food Wagon's core features: the [b]Snack Crafting System[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Crowdfunding Announcement[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/db36ee54ab5ed9357e3f68f4c199d72df11222d3.png"][/img][/p][p]Food Wagon is a project that our team has carefully built from start to finish.[/p][p]To deliver a more polished game, we will soon begin crowdfunding.[/p][p]This campaign will be an important step to ensure the final phase of development continues smoothly.[/p][p]We kindly ask for your support so that Food Wagon can reach you as an even more complete experience.[/p][p] [/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Snack Crafting System[/b][/h2][p]In Food Wagon, snacks are not just simple items. They are [b]customized creations designed with strategy and creativity[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/3e05ebe600d6a88bdcf9f6d084cf774f36715c7f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Puzzle-Based Combination[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/0436c7b6fd8e6be4ea0f4aeb7a7fb2d248289bcf.jpg"][/img]Arrange tetromino-shaped ingredient blocks into limited slots, optimizing space to increase the quality of the result.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Synergy and Strategy[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/074be61f4b89588b6ce8d076f3b4dcc75a2d5581.jpg"][/img]Each ingredient has unique effects and restrictions, and combining them in different ways creates new synergies.[/p][p]For example, when using a powerful meat ingredient, you need to pair it with vegetables that reduce fullness load.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Ingredient Refinement[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/ecd0b69169ee5c7f661b3ce3b21c2a4fc45626b0.jpg"][/img]If the block shape does not fit, it can be transformed into another tetromino, expanding strategic options.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Recipe Storage and Reuse[/b][/p][p]Completed combinations can be saved as recipes, and as long as you have the ingredients, they can be crafted instantly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Snack crafting in Food Wagon is the process of finding the best solution under ever-changing conditions.[/p][p]Players are not simply following fixed recipes but [b]creating their own unique recipes[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]What’s Next[/b][/h2][p]Food Wagon will soon release a demo and share crowdfunding news.[/p][p]Through weekly update notes and new content introductions, we will continue sharing the growth of Food Wagon.[/p][p]We will actively reflect your opinions and feedback to create an even more polished game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]With gratitude,[/b][/h3][p]Luminous Tales[/p]

notes.title: [Food Wagon Dev Note] Introducing the Main Fields
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is Luminous Tales.[/p][p]Today, we’d like to introduce five major fields that will appear in the full version of Food Wagon.[/p][p]Each one brings a distinct atmosphere and charm, adding more color to Lanya’s journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/140ecd81f076206c8c2132b6ea5f018d37961f0b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Veggie Field [/b]— A Living Field Where Vegetables Grow[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/dd5e979963176fd9babc5ec4f7964a132b5d3959.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]On sunny days, lively green sprouts bounce from the earth like they’re greeting you.[/p][/*][*][p]This place, filled with vegetables stretching their leaves and blooming in rows, feels like a kind garden once tenderly cultivated.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Brine Bay [/b]—[b] [/b]A Salty Breeze Blows Along the Coast[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/a27a01b81f27d5864b12fef26b3db000eee47050.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A salty breeze arrives before the waves.[/p][/*][*][p]The shimmering seawater and wind brushing over the sand gently rustle the fabric of the Food Wagon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Froyo Peak [/b]— A Frozen Summit of Sprawling Snowfields[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/21178bfcc057ac5faee278d4568e3ab81b3dd209.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A snow-covered mountain where layers of snow and cream-soft hills stretch endlessly.[/p][/*][*][p]The entire mountain feels like a giant dessert, offering a unique experience amidst the cold scenery.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Grill Mountain [/b]— A Rocky Hill Where Flames Breathe[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/1be7a589daeb8c4695fe0cca09a021caed22ddba.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Charred traces of long-burning flames remain in every crevice.[/p][/*][*][p]Even the air feels hot here, and the wheels of the Food Wagon carefully roll across heated stone.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]??? [/b]— An Unrevealed Location[/h2][p]This field appears later in Lanya’s journey and is deeply tied to the secrets of the Food Wagon world.[/p][p]Its environment, monsters, and cooking system follow entirely different rules from the other fields.[/p][p]You’ll be able to discover it for yourself in the official release.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Lanya’s Journey Continues[/b][/h3][p]The world of Food Wagon is not just about gathering ingredients,[/p][p]it’s a journey through the emotions and memories that dwell in each region.[/p][p]We’ll continue to share new development updates.[/p][p][/p][h3]With gratitude,[/h3][p]Luminous Tales[/p]

notes.title: The Village’s Versatile Technician - Ciabatta
notes.notes: [p]Hello, this is Luminous Tales.[/p][p]In this week’s development log, we’d like to introduce your reliable companion, [b]Ciabatta[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/33abe6478115fd628c90eb8070e57f0ae11b09f8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]A Cherished Artisan of the Village[/h3][p]Ciabatta, who works at the village forge, has a talent for fixing broken things and creating new ones.[/p][p]She may seem ordinary at first glance, but her skillful handling of the heavy blacksmith’s hammer leaves a strong impression on the villagers.[/p][p]She shares a close, almost father-daughter relationship with the village’s other technician, the puppet craftsman Focaccia, who is like a father figure to her.[/p][h3]Hands That Fix Anything[/h3][p]Throughout the game, Ciabatta plays an important role in Ranya’s growth.[/p][p][b]- Repairing the village using materials Lanya gathers[/b][/p][p][b]- Enhancing the game’s iconic Food Wagon[/b][/p][p][b]- Upgrading our weapons for greater power[/b][/p][p]She’ll help you and the village grow together.[/p][h3]Plans Going Forward[/h3][p]We’re finally able to share stories featuring repeated adventures with the village as your base.[/p][p]We’re working hard so that, [b]in July[/b], you can get your hands on the demo featuring the new game system.[/p][p][/p][p]Soon, we’ll also share updates about game systems—not just new characters or maps.[/p][p]If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you always,[/h3][p]Luminous Tales[/p]

notes.title: Mysterious Puppet Craftsman - Focaccia
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Luminous Tales!
This week, I'd like to introduce Focaccia, one of the village characters we mentioned before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/2024d0c6deb29fe730a574bdb964c94798aa343d.jpg[/img]

[h2]A Craftsman from Outside[/h2]

Focaccia is not from this village.
One day he suddenly appeared and began creating and repairing marionettes that work for the villagers.
He's middle-aged with a well-groomed beard that makes him look kind, but he remains a mysterious figure to the villagers.

[h2]Role in the Game[/h2]

Focaccia and his marionettes will provide convenience features for players in the village.
Through the marionette system, players will be able to manage resources more efficiently and enjoy village life.

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]

New plans are currently in the development stage,
and we're working hard to let players experience the new system.
We'll do our best to implement the system and bring you content as soon as possible.

We'll continue to show our efforts in creating a good game.
If you have any questions or opinions about development, please feel free to leave comments anytime.

[h3]With gratitude,[/h3]
Luminous Tales

notes.title: News After a Long Time, and a New Beginning: Village System
notes.notes:
Hello, it's been a while...  
It's been a long time since we last greeted you.
We apologize for not sharing updates over the past period.  
During this time, we've been working to secure development funding and, at the same time, focusing on enhancing the overall quality of our game design.  
Although there wasn't much visible progress, it was a meaningful period for solidifying the foundation of the game.

[h2]Design Improvements: Strengthening the Roguelite Identity  [/h2]
Previously, our game placed a bit more emphasis on survival and exploration elements.  
However, based on feedback, we have refined the design to be more faithful to the roguelite genre.  
We've clarified the game loop to deliver a new experience each time you play,  
and also strengthened the connection between character progression and the world.

We are confident that these changes will be meaningful for players.

[h2]Village System: Heart of the Adventure  [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/0479218c85658c801d24652cf5f4618bf649dcdd.jpg[/img]
The "Village System" we introduce today is a new core element of our game.  
This area serves as a safe haven without combat, where you can stay and interact with various NPCs to unfold stories.

As your adventure continues, the village will also change and grow together.  
You will see NPCs strolling around, buildings improving, and the overall atmosphere of the village evolving.  
Through this, you will be able to sense that your journey is truly impacting this world.

This medieval fantasy village, depicted in a cute graphic style, will offer a mysterious atmosphere  
and become a special place of rest for weary adventurers.

[h2]Future Plans  [/h2]
Going forward, we will provide development updates more frequently.  
We plan to continue sharing regular progress reports.  
We will do our best to create a more valuable game that rewards your patience.

We appreciate your interest and support!

[b]With gratitude, [/b] 
Luminous Tales

notes.title: Food Wagon Dev Log #1
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Luminous Tales!

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for the warm support you showed us during the recent Steam Next Fest. We have been working diligently to improve the game over the past few weeks.

In this development log, we would like to share with you our progress and future plans.

[h1]Development Highlights[/h1]

[h2]Demo Improvements[/h2]

We have enhanced the demo version based on the feedback you provided. We are striving to offer a more enjoyable gaming experience.

[list]
[*] [b]Localization Issue Fix:[/b] We have resolved the issue where localized text was not displayed correctly. Now, you can enjoy Luminous Tales in various languages.
[*] [b]Gameplay Fixes:[/b] We fixed issues such as being able to add items during cooking and the inventory item duplication bug, enhancing game stability.
[*] We are also addressing other bugs and inconveniences mentioned in your feedback.
[/list]

[h2]Trading System Development[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/f2c598dea014be40bbc9b0f05a6ce774e743b3e6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We are developing a new trading system.
[*] We are reinforcing the functions that the Food Wagon should provide.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/418c759bdf7952cfcd92aff71f5f94688d36dc9a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We have developed customer NPCs for the trading system to add more vitality.
[*] [b]Now, you can earn gold through trading![/b]
[/list]

[h2]New Contents[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/8efcf3c765dc8b5e59c5042d2ff5da56d5b3bcf9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/bba2bf44bdb36d818e052ac7c2332bf4cf423ed9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/af7cfb97bc55a358fd753cd169f934891ef2d32b.png[/img]
We are creating maps and boss monsters for upcoming content. You will experience more exciting battles and attractions.

[h1]Game Direction[/h1]

The Luminous Tales development team is deeply discussing how to evolve the game to bring the best joy to our users. The following conditions are being discussed as core conditions and will be implemented:

[list]
[*] Strengthening game narrative
[*] Maintaining Look & Feel while fully improving the core loop
[*] Expanding Food Wagon-related content
[/list]

Although the Food Wagon still has a long way to go, we will analyze your valuable feedback diligently and strive to incorporate it well into the game. We look forward to your continued support.

This concludes our development log for now.

We will continue to update regularly to show you the progress of the Food Wagon.

[h3]With gratitude,[/h3]
Luminous Tales

notes.title: Reflection on STEAM Next Fest and Future Plans
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439465/965b4d809085ce5800c6ac97f1d02bef602776c4.png[/img]

Hello!
This is Luminous Tales.

Honestly, we were quite nervous and worried as this was our first time participating in Steam Next Fest and launching our debut game. Our entire team was surprised by the unexpectedly high level of interest from so many people. We are simply grateful.

Though we're still lacking, we will grow step by step.
The current version of Food Wagon is still in its early development stages. Nevertheless, the main reason we decided to participate in Next Fest this time was to hear your honest feedback and opinions as early as possible.

Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've learned about our direction. We're especially grateful to those who showed interest in our game based on the visuals alone, and to those who took the time to play and provide valuable feedback.

Because of you, we now clearly understand what we need to improve and how to move forward. 
While there were some shortcomings in this demo, we will carefully incorporate the opinions we received and return with a more polished demo in the future!

Please look forward to Food Wagon's next appearance.

We plan to regularly update you on our development process and changes.
We hope you'll continue to follow our journey and help guide our wagon in the right direction with your sharp critiques and sincere advice!

Once again, we sincerely thank everyone who showed interest and provided feedback. We will work hard for the enjoyment of our players.

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

Luminous Tales

notes.title: FoodWagon Demo Launch! 🚀
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hello, Steam community! 🙋‍♂️
[/h3][/b]
Today, the demo version of [b]FoodWagon[/b] has been released! 🎉 In this demo, a chapter with a beautiful nature and meadow concept is available, allowing you to explore with Lanya and experience the natural world.

Key Features of the Demo:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tw3C0MU.jpeg[/img]
[h3]1. [b]Explore with Lanya! [/b]🌳[/h3]

Pull the FoodWagon and explore the beautiful natural world with Lanya. 
Discover hidden secrets of this other world and enjoy various adventures.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qWBtipI.jpeg[/img]
[h3][b]2. Battle with Various Monsters! 🐺[/b][/h3]

Engage in battles with cute animal monsters to obtain cooking ingredients. 
By cooking and consuming these dishes, you can gain powerful [b]buffs.[/b] 
Especially, defeating the [b]Deer of Nature[/b] will reward you with the [b]biggest prize[/b] available in the demo version!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/slHDzlQ.jpeg[/img]
[h3]3. [b]Free Cooking Experience![/b] 🍳[/h3]

As the only chef in this other world, cook freely by combining ingredients as you like. 
In this demo, the [b]skewer cooking[/b] method is introduced first, 
allowing you to cook with various ingredients and consume them to gain [b]buffs[/b]

[h3][b]Try the FoodWagon Demo! [/b]🎮[/h3]

Experience the charm of FoodWagon and share your thoughts with us! Your feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you! 😊

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5hxnWuG.gif[/img]

Hello, this is [b]Luminous Tales[/b], the developer of [b]Food Wagon.[/b]

Since the launch of our game page, over [b]3,000 people[/b] have added Food Wagon to their wishlist in just three weeks! 

We would like to take this opportunity to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you.

Food Wagon handed in first demo build on February 10 and is currently undergoing review. 

We are excited to announce that the demo will be availabl e for you to experience during the Steam Next Fest, starting February 24.
Until then, we plan to use this place to share more about the adorable Lanya, whom you'll meet in the demo, as well as the diverse content we have in store for you.

Food Wagon is a action roguelike game. It follows Lanya, who finds herself in another world and embarks on a journey with her companion to:

- Grow stronger through hunting,
- Create various dishes through cooking,
- Enhance her abilities by consuming food,
- Serve foods to the residents of this new world,
- and find a way back home.

We’re cooking up a fascinating world and dishing out sneak peeks along the way—so hop aboard, because the Food Wagon adventure is just getting started!
